description: This is a bar chart titled "Comprehensive Evaluation Results on Academic and Practical Benchmarks". The x-axis represents different datasets and metrics, including GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC Alpac Eval2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The y-axis represents the score percentage, ranging from 0 to 80. There are four sets of bars, each representing a different model: LLaMA-3-8B-inst, Ours (SFT baseline), Ours (DPO baseline), and Ours (Iterative RLHF). The bars are color-coded to distinguish between the models. The chart shows the performance of each model across the different datasets and metrics.
